messages:
Sophie W: Heads-up — planning to lift the runtime/model freeze for the llama3-q variants tonight during the 23:00-23:30 PT change window. Need a final compatibility pass and signoff. deploy-bot will unfreeze the pinlist if checks are green. Ping @kevin.l @Maria C @Jonathan P :eyes:

deploy-bot: Change window created cw-20260320-01 (start=1867509123 end=1867510923). Will run job `compat-smoke-v2` against a 5% canary subset and then roll to 25% if green.

kevin.l: Quick note — SDK 1.4.2 has a breaking change around the `kv_cache` param. Runtime r3.0 must accept both `kv_cache: true` and `kv_cache: auto`. I pushed a compatibility shim to `edge/kv-shim` that we should include in the canary if possible. If tests fail we should keep the runtime pin. :construction:

Maria C: Compat run started (canary 5%). First batch failing on embeddings route. Snippet: ```Error: shape mismatch at matmul, expected [32,4096] got [16,4096]``` Repro locally on r3.0 + llama3-q quantized. Investigating. :mag:

Jonathan P: If that's a batching boundary issue, we can force the canary to use strict batching to avoid unit-of-work size changes. Suggest override: `batching.max_tokens: 1024` and `batching.mode: strict` for the initial canary. That should prevent variable micro-batch sizes.

Maria C: Tried strict batching on canary -> error goes away. Running full smoke now. Also pushed a small fallback that forces non-quantized kernel when sequence_len < 64 to avoid the matmul edge.

deploy-bot: compat-smoke-v2: canary 5% -> PASS. Regression check against prompt set (chat + embeddings) shows no diffs exceeding thresholds. Canary -> 25% rollout queued. Ready to unfreeze pinlist. Command to unfreeze: `deploy unpin --target=pinlist-runtime --id=pin-2026-03-20 --force`

Sophie W: Nice. @ops-bot can you confirm rollback policy: auto-fallback to runtime r2.14 if p95 latency > 500ms OR error rate > 1% during the first 30m post-unfreeze? Also ensure alerts go to on-call.

ops-bot: Rollback thresholds confirmed and set: `p95_latency>500ms` OR `error_rate>1%` for a 30m evaluation window => auto-rollback to runtime `r2.14`. On-call alerted after first triggered window. Alerts: #oncall, #eng-sre. :white_check_mark:

Maria C: Full smoke finished, all checks green. Approving the unfreeze. Please add a one-line release note: "Lifted runtime pin for llama3-q; canary using strict batching; auto-rollback thresholds enabled."

kevin.l: :thumbsup: I'll backport the kv_cache shim to SDK 1.4.3 and cut a patch if anything pops. Monitoring client-side telemetry as well.

Sophie W: Thanks everyone. I'll trigger the `deploy unpin` in ~10m and monitor metrics + traces. Will post final status after the window. :rocket:
